ldr r2,=0x80FF3344
str r2,[r4,#0]
str r2,[r4,#4]
str r2,[r4,#8]
movs r1,#1
gbl_probe_0:
ldr r0,[r4,r1]
GBL_ASSERT_EQ r0, 0x4480FF33, 0x4480FF32

independent_expectation.derivation: LDR at initialized IWRAM base0x03004000+1; word0x80FF3344 little-endian lanes; independent expected 0x4480FF33. Stores are checked by reloading entire affected word; odd halfword aligns/rotates per source policy.
